summary: The clips of “hey k9” from the `community-hey-k9` test set, placed between seconds of read speech, followed by hours of audio with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `community-hey-k9` at OpenVoiceOS/ovos-community-wakewords-dataset@1a3ad631 (46 of 46 clips with the phrase) and the shared negative recordings.
